title:
Comment of Julie Merrick in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15424-000
Submission Date: 10/19/2026

documents.name: 151667.txt
documents.text:
Julie Merrick, South Freeport, ME.
The coast of Maine has the most beautiful scenic views and our coastal waters are inhabited by so many species. Putting a data center in the ocean ( Bay of Fundy) would be an insensitive move that will have detrimental effects on those species and the surrounding ecosystem. It’s not something to risk. We care about those species, their habitat and environmental impact. The Bay of Funday is also a critical habitat for the endangered North Atlantic Right Whale. It’s important to be responsible and consider the harm that could come from destroying an environment that species rely on. I do not support this real estate business doing this.
